observation: Five interpenetrating cubes of clearly different edge length, each on its own two-axis orientation, fused into one squat mound on the unchanged 28 mm circular foot. Wider than it is tall; every face is a flat square or a clean intersection triangle; no lobe, dome, sphere or round surface survives. No cube floats or detaches, the smallest face measures 5.77 mm2 and the sharpest convex edge is a 42 degree wedge 0.79 mm long, so there is no sliver facet and no blade. The mound stays inside the foot outline. All four bubble packets render byte-identical images to this one. These three views are byte-identical to the previous round's, which the Manager inspected in full.
